title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 6: David brings up the ark of God, Uzzah dies, and David dances before Yahweh.

questions.text: How many chosen men of Israel did David gather?
questions.explanation: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

questions.text: On what did they set God's ark?
questions.explanation: They set God's ark on a new cart and brought it out of Abinadab's house.

questions.text: Why did Uzzah take hold of God's ark?
questions.explanation: At the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God's ark and took hold of it, for the cattle stumbled.

questions.text: What did David call the place where Uzzah died?
questions.explanation: David called that place Perez Uzzah, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah.

questions.text: Into whose house did David carry the ark aside?
questions.explanation: David would not move the ark into David's city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite's house.

questions.text: How long did the ark remain in Obed-Edom's house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite's house three months, and Yahweh blessed him and all his house.

questions.text: What did David sacrifice when those who bore the ark had gone six paces?
questions.explanation: When those who bore Yahweh's ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.

answers.text: An ox and a fattened calf

questions.text: What was David clothed in as he danced before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: David danced before Yahweh with all his might, clothed in a linen ephod.

questions.text: Who looked out through the window and despised David in her heart?
questions.explanation: Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window, saw David leaping and dancing, and despised him in her heart.

questions.text: What does the chapter say about Michal at its end?
questions.explanation: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.

answers.text: She left Jerusalem and never returned
She asked David for his forgiveness
She went back to her husband Paltiel
She had no child to the day of her death
